entities.summary: Sungha Jung (b. 1996-09-02, Cheongju) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Cheongju and South Korea. Known in the fields of south korea, composers & musicians, asia.
